column1: # name<TAB>arguments (shell words, run in this directory; "< file" = stdin). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 dustmasker 1.0.0 on ws (env_blast), 2026-11-12, ad-RG-K-1.

# -infmt blastdb: the databases in db/ were made by NCBI makeblastdb 2.17.0 from in/ (basic, deflines -> defl, nruns, ambig, short, protfirst -> prot, more_defl -parse_seqids -> mdefl_ps); @CWD@ in the expected text is this directory.

# OID ranges of an alias file (db/oidr.nal: DBLIST basic, FIRST_OID 2, LAST_OID 3): NCBI's CMaskBDBReader reads every OID of the volumes (GetNumOIDs), the range leaves none out. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-2.

# -conffile (line RG item E1 on dev: the command line's application start loads it in place of dustmasker.ini): conf/blastdb.ini sets [BLAST] BLASTDB=db, conf/malformed.ini has a line without '='. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-2.

# An alias value that NCBI cannot convert (db/lenbad.nal: DBLIST basic, LENGTH abc): NCBI reports the CStringException, exit status 3. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-2 (review 2 F6).
# -dryrun (line RG item E1b on dev): the arguments are read, nothing runs. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-2.

# Alias values that only a search reads differently (review 2 of K1, F5): db/len0.nal (DBLIST basic, LENGTH 0), db/nseqneg.nal (NSEQ -5), db/firstbig.nal (FIRST_OID 3000000000), and the ranged db/oidr with another name (db/short). NCBI's CMaskBDBReader reads every OID with GetBioseq, as without the alias file. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-3.
